scope: Before/after Callgrind measurement of the completed font-query-payload patch; guest instruction event Ir, paragraph build only.

conclusion.overall: All 22 workloads reduce collected build instructions. Multi-size 64-style cases: approximately 1.3-3.2% reduction for ordinary tags, 1.1-2.0% reduction for 1156-byte tags. Paint-only 64-style Latin cases: approximately 4.6-5.4% reduction.
conclusion.cause: Borrowed query identities and vacant-entry-only payload creation reduce String cloning and malloc/free work. In-place language normalization also reduces work outside itemize in font-query preparation.
conclusion.attribution: Latin ordinary-tag itemize inclusive instructions fall approximately 17-19% with different font sizes, 20-23% for paint-only styles. Paint-only Latin String::clone inclusive instructions fall approximately 91-94%. Inclusive function counts overlap; these reductions must not be added together.
conclusion.long_tag_tradeoff: For Latin 1156-byte tags, itemize inclusive instructions increase approximately 6.5% because borrowed ASCII-folded hashing adds work; the complete build still decreases approximately 2.0%. This patch optimizes total build work, not every individual function.
conclusion.repeatability: Four representative workloads repeated for both versions; total instruction variation versus first run is below 0.5% and reductions retain the same sign.
conclusion.limits: Instruction reductions are not elapsed-time or cycle speedups. No Callgrind cache/branch simulation, page/PNG benchmark or Parley rerun was performed for this patch.

conditions.profile: release opt-level default, CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=1 in both archives, default complex-scripts, no allocation-counting
conditions.sources: Same clean baseline and candidate archives as implementation record, only the two production files differ. Profiling example identical between versions.
conditions.cases: Latin, CJK fallback, variable emoji, size-adjust; none/same/ASCII-case/distinct/1156-byte language tags. Also Latin paint-only styles with no tag and EN-us.
conditions.input: 64 one-character styled spans, prepared ParagraphBuilder; fresh LayoutContext for each build.
conditions.collection: --collect-atstart=no --toggle-collect=shodo_query_profile_build. Exact exported non-inlined wrapper executes only measured builder.build calls, with post-build black_box preventing a tail call. All captured Ir equals wrapper inclusive Ir. Three wrapper invocations verified in every profile.
conditions.exclusions: Font loading, builder creation, three warmup builds, output snapshot/line breaking, timer handling, JSON output and returned Paragraph/context destruction occur outside captured Ir.
conditions.sampling: 22 workloads x 2 versions x 3 builds = 132 measured builds; repeat 4 representative workloads x 2 versions x 3 builds = 24 additional measured builds. 52 profiles in total.
conditions.call_count_caveat: Raw Callgrind call counts for shared callees can include uncollected setup/warmup invocations. Only wrapper call count is used to normalize Ir; allocator call reductions come from the separate CountingAllocator measurement.
conditions.output: Every before/after/repeat geometry, font-instance/glyph/paint and warning digest matches per workload.

runner_source:
from pathlib import Path
import json, os, subprocess, sys, hashlib
p = Path(sys.argv[1])
only = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None
outdir = p / 'callgrind'
outdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
fixtures = ['latin-multi-style', 'cjk-fallback-multi-style', 'variable-multi-style', 'size-adjust-multi-style']
configs = [(f, m, False) for f in fixtures for m in ['none', 'same', 'case', 'distinct', 'long']]
configs += [('latin-multi-style', m, True) for m in ['none', 'same']]
for repeat in range(2):
    selected = configs if repeat == 0 else [('latin-multi-style', m, False) for m in ['none','same','long']] + [('latin-multi-style', 'none', True)]
    for fixture, mode, paint_only in selected:
        versions = ['before', 'after'] if repeat == 0 else ['after', 'before']
        for version in versions:
            label = f"{version}-{fixture}-{mode}-{'paint' if paint_only else 'size'}-{repeat}"
            if only is not None and label != only:
                continue
            result_file = outdir / (label + '.json')
            if result_file.exists():
                continue
            env = dict(os.environ, SHODO_QUERY_LANG=mode, SHODO_QUERY_FIXTURE=fixture)
            env.pop('SHODO_QUERY_PAINT_ONLY', None)
            if paint_only:
                env['SHODO_QUERY_PAINT_ONLY'] = '1'
            binary = p / (version + '-query-callgrind')
            profile = outdir / (label + '.out')
            args = ['valgrind', '--tool=callgrind', '--collect-atstart=no', '--toggle-collect=shodo_query_profile_build', '--cache-sim=no', '--branch-sim=no', '--error-exitcode=99', '--callgrind-out-file=' + str(profile), str(binary), 'time']
            result = subprocess.run(args, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
            (outdir / (label + '.log')).write_text(result.stderr)
            (outdir / (label + '.stdout')).write_text(result.stdout)
            if result.returncode != 0:
                raise RuntimeError((label, result.returncode, result.stderr))
            rows = [json.loads(line) for line in result.stdout.splitlines()]
            assert len(rows) == 3 and all(not row['output']['warnings'] for row in rows)
            summary = [line for line in profile.read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('summary:')]
            assert len(summary) == 1, summary
            instructions = int(summary[0].split()[1])
            assert instructions > 100000, (label, instructions)
            for inclusive in ['yes', 'no']:
                annotation = subprocess.check_output(['callgrind_annotate', '--auto=no', '--show=Ir', '--show-percs=no', '--threshold=100', '--inclusive=' + inclusive, str(profile)], text=True)
                (outdir / (label + ('.inclusive.txt' if inclusive == 'yes' else '.self.txt'))).write_text(annotation)
            metadata = dict(label=label, version=version, fixture=fixture, language_case=mode, paint_only=paint_only, repeat=repeat, builds=3, total_instructions=instructions, instructions_per_build=instructions / 3, outputs=[row['output'] for row in rows], raw_sha256=hashlib.sha256(profile.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
            result_file.write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + '\n')
            print(label, instructions, flush=True)
